b="${REMOTE_SSH_MSG_BASE:-$HOME/.claude/remote-ssh}"; for f in "$b"/inbox/*/*.json ${REMOTE_SSH_RUNTIME_BASE:-/tmp/remote-ssh-*}/*/context/*.md; do [ -e "$f" ] && exec python3 -S "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" UserPromptSubmit; done; exec cat >/dev/null

b="${REMOTE_SSH_MSG_BASE:-$HOME/.claude/remote-ssh}"; for f in "$b"/inbox/*/*.json ${REMOTE_SSH_RUNTIME_BASE:-/tmp/remote-ssh-*}/*/context/*.md; do [ -e "$f" ] && exec python3 -S "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" PostToolUse; done; exec cat >/dev/null
